name: development-spring
description: Spring framework TOPIC plugin — composes alongside development-java (#296) for Java + Spring Boot repos. A maintenance dispatcher that audits Spring configuration via the spring-config-advisor agent (deprecated/relocated Boot 3.x property keys, actuator over-exposure). Holds zero Java-foundation logic and reuses java-ci-fixer for CI. Incremental: config audit in v0.1; Spring Boot 2→3 Jakarta migration, bootBuildImage container generation, and the contract-first API drift gate land in later slices of the #296 epic.
